# Feature Status Report

*This file is auto-generated with each release and contains detailed feature status.*

## Format

Each feature includes:
- Feature name and description
- Current status (Implemented, In Development, Planned, Research, Deprecated)
- Target release (if known)
- Known limitations
- Related components

## Updates

This report is updated:
- On each major/minor release
- When feature status changes significantly
- When component owners request updates

See [capability-matrix.md](./capability-matrix.md) for high-level capability overview.
